assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle ABC with an interior point P and the cevians AD, BE, CF; the parts PD, PE, PF are red. Three dashed shaded equilateral triangles have apex P and bases on BC (from V to U, side x, blue), on CA (orange) and on AB (green); D lies between V and U.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the auxiliary construction of the three small equilateral triangles through P, whose sides add up to 1, and a comparison of each cevian piece with one of them.
